messages:
Sara (CS): Kickoff: Altair Labs renewal exec — they want to add 60 seats, convert to a 9mo term, and need a PO/vendor-code update. Tagging @mike-sales and @ben-legal. We need procurement path + wet-sign vs DocuSign fallback. Onboarding enablement is blocked until signature.

Mike (Sales): Saw this. Pricing approved at $120k for 9mo. Customer finance asked for net45; sales prefers net30. @Nate (Finance) any constraints on revenue recognition or approvals?

Ben (Legal): 9mo term is fine. Need exec-level signer on their side — procurement PO alone won't cut it for the amendment. I can draft the amendment and include the data-residency clause they requested. Will send redline today.

Nate (Finance): Net45 is acceptable if credit check is green. If sales wants net30 we can offer early pay discount (2%/10). Confirm customer legal entity and we can match PO.

Olivia (CS-Ops): Heads up — enablement slot booked the week of 5/10, but we won't start until contract fully executed. If they implement a staggered signflow (PO first, exec later) we can provide preliminary access for up to 10 seats to avoid blocking their team.

Sara (CS): Customer procurement sent PO ALT-2026-1023 but vendor code is blank. They said they'd update to '9001' if we confirm billing entity string. Who can confirm the exact billing name to provide to procurement?

Mike (Sales): Billing entity = Redwood Inference, Inc. Use "Redwood Inference, Inc. (TIN 12-3456789)". I'll email the procurement contact and push for the vendor code update + net30.

Ben (Legal): For the amendment header use: `Amendment to Master Services Agreement — Altair Labs`. Also include: `No change to liability limits` and the SOW attachment reference. I'll attach a redline in this thread once ready.

Sara (CS): Pasting PO snippet for reference:
```
PO: ALT-2026-1023
Vendor code: <pending>
Amount: $120,000
Term: 9 months
```
Can someone update the vendor code field in the DocuSign envelope once procurement confirms?

Docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope created (env_0x1a2b). Signers: procurement_contact@altair.com (routing), exec_signer@altair.com (pending). Envelope status: sent.

Nate (Finance): Once vendor code is present we can match the PO and schedule invoice release after signature. Please send billing email to invoices@redwood.ai so AP can watch for it.

Olivia (CS-Ops): If they want staggered seat enablement, we'll provision a 10-seat pilot immediately after PO confirmation and full provisioning after exec signature. I'll coordinate dates once envelope shows signed.

Mike (Sales): On it — I'll chase procurement for the vendor code update and follow up with the exec for signature. Will report back here by EOD.

Sara (CS): Action list: 1) Mike to confirm vendor code update by EOD; 2) Ben to upload amendment redline; 3) Nate to confirm final net terms based on credit; 4) Olivia to hold onboarding slot and prep staggered pilot plan. Ping here when PO updated or envelope status changes. :thumbsup:
